The '''double-barreled blaster carbine''' was a powerful [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] small enough to conceal under loose clothing. Unlike a normal [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]], the double-[[Barrel/Legends|barreled]] carbine did not have an autofire setting, however it could be switched to a "double shot" mode which allowed the weapon to fire two shots at the same time, targeting a wider area.

The double-barreled carbine had a close-range [[Stun/Legends|stun]] setting as well, meaning the wielder could switch the weapon to fire stun shots instead of lethal fire, however the close-range stun setting was limited to a range of only 9 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. A double-barreled blaster carbine required a [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] to operate; after 50 shots, the power pack needed to be replaced. This weapon cost 1,200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase, but its ownership and use was regulated by local authorities.

The double-barreled carbine was a favorite among those who lived on the [[Fringer/Legends|fringe]] of society. [[Cade Skywalker]] carried a [[Rawk chopped special|custom double-barreled blaster carbine]] that was modified for him by chief mechanic and former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Rawk|"Bantha" Rawk]].
